title: DAWN: Robust Neural Blind Deconvolution via Alternating Wiener Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.25621v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to jointly recover a sharp image and blur kernel from a single degraded observation. Under nontrivial and high noise, which is common in photography and scientific imaging such as microscopy, BID remains particularly challenging, as existing methods suffer from noise overfitting and inaccurate kernel estimation. Existing training-data-free learning methods for BID, such as those based on the deep image prior (DIP), often utilize external guidance by including model-based estimates as additional loss terms, which underexploits the information these estimates carry especially under nontrivial noise. To address these challenges, we propose DAWN, a training-data-free DIP framework that alternates between injecting model-based estimates directly into the model input and refining this imperfect estimate with the network's own prior. translated_title: DAWN：通过交替维纳引导实现鲁棒的神经盲去卷积
translated_abstract: 盲图像去卷积（BID）是一个病态逆问题，旨在从单幅退化观测中联合恢复清晰图像和模糊核。在摄影和显微镜等科学成像中常见的显著高噪声条件下，BID 尤其具有挑战性，因为现有方法存在噪声过拟合和模糊核估计不准确的问题。现有的无训练数据 BID 学习方法，例如基于深度图像先验（DIP）的方法，通常通过将基于模型的估计作为额外损失项来引入外部引导，这在显著噪声条件下尤其未能充分利用这些估计所携带的信息。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DAWN，这是一个无需训练数据的 DIP 框架，它在将基于模型的估计直接注入模型输入与利用网络自身先验精炼这一不完美估计之间交替进行。为了提供更可靠的核估计……
tldr: 提出 DAWN 框架，通过交替地将基于模型的维纳估计注入模型输入并利用网络自身先验对其进行精炼，在高噪声条件下实现了无需训练数据的鲁棒盲图像去卷积。
en_tdlr: DAWN is a training-data-free DIP framework that robustly performs blind image deconvolution under high noise by alternating between injecting model-based Wiener estimates into the model input and refining them with the network's own prior.
